pros_and_cons.editorial_summary: option from Kotak Mahindra Bank suited for travel & miles users with 8 domestic lounge visits/yr.
pros: Targeted rewards structure backed by Kotak Mahindra Bank
cons: High joining/annual fee (Rs. 3,000 + GST) if spend thresholds aren't met
High 3.5% (+GST) foreign currency markup — poor for overseas spends
Check latest issuer exclusions on rent, utilities, education & wallet loads before high spends

reddit_user_feedback.sentiment_summary: Community discussions around Kotak Mahindra Bank Travel & Miles cards.
practical_community_warnings: Verify quarterly spend threshold before relying on complimentary lounge entry.
High 3.5% (+GST) forex markup makes international swipes net negative.
optimization_tips: Avoid foreign currency & international SaaS charges on this card due to 3.5% + GST forex markup; use a 0%-forex card instead.
Check spend criteria and pre-generate terminal QR access via official portals (LoungeOne.ai / TFS / HOI) before arriving at the airport.

devaluation_history: RBI digital embargo recovery era + PVR/White/Myntra reward & lounge reductions.
watch_out_vectors: Quarterly spend thresholds for domestic airport lounge access
